race.comment: INYUN (2) is the one to beat if she puts the last-start mishap behind her, having been sent out favourite at this track before losing the rider after beginning only fairly. Her Narromine fifth beforehand when beaten a length and a half after being bumped and charging home, and her one win and one placing from three starts at the distance give her the right grounding. ALLUSIVE INTENT (3) brings a different profile, dropping out of a BM58 at Dubbo where he made solid inroads from well back, and his previous Bathurst run also suggested he is looking for this sort of assignment. HELLFIRE HENRY (1) comes off a Canberra Mdn win over Pariah Time and has been building through the campaign, with the 1400m record reading well enough for this grade. ARGYLE LAIRD (8) has barrier one, a 1.5kg claim and a recent fourth at this track to keep him firmly in the contest. ACRODANCE (6) next best.
